note: Third-party skills this repo can use as optional extras. Each source is pinned to a commit that was read and checked (the first four on 2026-11-24, pstack on 2026-11-26). scripts/sync-upstream.mjs clones them into ./upstream (not in git). scripts/validate.mjs generates skills/<seat>/extras.md from this file.
